title: The subdivision–tropical oriented matroid correspondence
statement: Let $\Delta_{n-1}$ and $\Delta_{d-1}$ be simplices, and let a tropical oriented matroid have parameters $(n,d)$. A subdivision is a polyhedral subdivision of the product $\Delta_{n-1}\times\Delta_{d-1}$. **The subdivision–tropical oriented matroid correspondence.** There is a one-to-one correspondence between the subdivisions of $\Delta_{n-1}\times\Delta_{d-1}$ and the tropical oriented matroids with parameters $(n,d)$. Realizable tropical oriented matroids are already in canonical bijection with regular subdivisions; the conjecture asserts that this correspondence extends to all subdivisions and tropical oriented matroids, with the elimination axiom as the remaining issue in the stated partial results.
source_name: Federico Ardila and Mike Develin, “Tropical hyperplane arrangements and oriented matroids”, arXiv:0706.2920 (2007).
